caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular section of patterned wallpaper composed of vertical stripes in varying shades of beige and light yellow. Arranged in three columns, each separated by a wide pale yellow stripe bordered with thin lines, are bouquets of flowers featuring dark green leaves, green leafy sprigs, and purple and magenta blossoms. These floral motifs are spaced evenly both vertically and horizontally. Interspersed between the floral elements and aligned with the vertical stripes are small circular medallions colored in pink with a white center, also evenly spaced. The background color of the wallpaper is an off-white or light beige shade. The overall object placement is regular and symmetrical within the rectangular frame. The name "George Robin" appears faintly stamped or written in gray in the lower right section outside the patterned area.
title: Wall Paper
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
